question: Umbuzo
defaultDirections: Khetha impendulo ocabanga ukuthi iphendula umbuzo. Uma usuqedile, cindezela u-{checkAnswer}. Uzothola impendulo ekhombisa ukuthi impendulo yakho ilungile yini nokuthi uqhubeke kanjani.
relatedContentDescription: Lokhu kudala indawo egoqiwe yokuqukethwe okuhlobene nalo mbuzo futhi kuhlala kuboniswa
hintDescription: Lokhu kuboniswa uma umsebenzisi ephendula kabi
evidenceDescription: Lokhu kuboniswa uma umsebenzisi ephendula kahle
numericDirections: Thayipha inombolo. Iyunithi iboniswa wena. Uma usuqedile, khetha u-{checkAnswer}.
withinPercent: Izimpendulo ezingaphakathi kuka-{tolerance}% wenani eliqondile ziyabalwa.
withinAbsolute: Izimpendulo ezingaphakathi kuka-{tolerance} wenani eliqondile ziyabalwa.
formulaHelp: Inombolo, noma ifomula esebenzisa okuguquguqukayo okungezansi, isibonelo d / (t / 60). Amafomula angasebenzisa + - * / ^, abakaki, sqrt() kanye ne-abs().
tokensHelp: Bonisa okuguquguqukayo embuzweni ngokubhala igama lakho kubakaki abagobile, isibonelo {d}.
keyProblem: Lokhu akukwazi ukubalwa okwamanje. Hlola ukuthi wonke amagama akufomula ayizinto eziguquguqukayo.
